en.name: Pickled herring
en.summary: Pickled herring is raw herring salted and marinated in vinegar or a wine sauce — cured, never cooked. An unopened commercial jar keeps 4–6 months refrigerated; once opened, 1–2 weeks. The freezing that matters happens to the raw fish before marinating, as the parasite control.
en.pantry: Pickled herring is a refrigerated food, whatever the shelf you bought it from looked like. Keep an unopened jar at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and never at room temperature. Home-marinated or deli-counter herring is a different thing altogether: it is a lightly salted raw fish sitting in a mild acid, it is not preserved to any meaningful degree, and it should be treated as a few days' food. Follow the 2-hour rule at the table, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: An unopened commercial glass jar in wine or vinegar sauce keeps 4–6 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Once the jar is open, keep every fillet submerged in its brine or sauce and use a clean fork, for 1–2 weeks — a deliberately short figure, because it is our own conservative reading rather than a published one. Cold-marinated fish is a ready-to-eat food with a long chilled shelf life, which is precisely the category flagged for Listeria monocytogenes: it grows at refrigerator temperature, and the longer the food sits the more of it there is. That is the reason not to stretch an opened jar.
en.freezer: Read this before you pickle your own. Salt and acid do not kill parasites; freezing does. The published parasite-destruction conditions are −20 °C or below for seven days in total, or −35 °C until solid and then held at −35 °C for fifteen hours, or −35 °C until solid and then held at −20 °C for twenty-four hours — and these may not suit fish thicker than about six inches. Brining and pickling may reduce the parasite hazard but they do not eliminate it; nematode larvae have survived four weeks in a very strong brine. So the freezing is a treatment applied to the raw fish before marinating, not a way of storing the finished jar, and no freezer timeline is given here: pickled herring frozen after the fact goes mushy and cloudy.
en.thawing: Thaw raw herring in the fridge before marinating, never on the counter. A finished jar should not be frozen, so there is nothing to thaw.
spoilage: Fillets gone grey-brown, mushy or falling apart.
A putrid or yeasty smell over the vinegar and spice.
A bulging lid, or gas bubbles rising in the jar.
tips: Keep every fillet under the liquid; the exposed ones spoil first.
Clean fork every time, and never return a fillet to the jar.
Write the opening date on the lid and keep to the short window.
If you pickle your own, freeze the raw herring first — the vinegar is not the control.

faq.q: How long does pickled herring keep?
faq.a: An unopened commercial jar keeps 4–6 months at 4 °C or below. Once opened, 1–2 weeks — a deliberately conservative figure, since none is published.

No. Brining and pickling may reduce the hazard but do not eliminate it; larvae have survived weeks in strong brine. Freezing at the published conditions is the control, and it must come before marinating.
No timeline is given, and it is not the point of freezing here. A finished jar thaws mushy and cloudy. Freeze the raw fish beforehand instead.

faq.q: Why is pickled herring a Listeria concern?
faq.a: It is a ready-to-eat fish kept chilled for a long time, and Listeria grows at refrigerator temperature. That is why an opened jar should not be stretched.

zh.name: 醃鯡魚
zh.summary: 醃鯡魚是生鯡魚經鹽漬後，再用醋或酒醬醃漬而成——是「醃」，不是「煮」。未開封的市售玻璃瓶冷藏可放 4～6 個月；開瓶後 1～2 週。真正重要的冷凍，發生在生魚醃漬之前，那是寄生蟲的控制步驟。
zh.pantry: 不管你是在哪一層貨架上拿到它的，醃鯡魚都是冷藏食品。未開封的瓶子請放 4 °C 以下，絕不放室溫。自家醃的或熟食櫃秤重的又完全是另一回事：那是輕度鹽漬的生魚泡在弱酸裡，幾乎談不上保存，請當成幾天內要吃完的食物。上桌時守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。
zh.fridge: 未開封的市售玻璃瓶（酒醬或醋漬）放 4 °C 以下可存 4～6 個月。開瓶之後，每片魚都要浸在醃汁裡、用乾淨的叉子取用，並在 1～2 週內吃完——這是刻意訂短的數字，因為它是我們保守的判讀而非公告值。冷漬魚是一種「冷藏期很長的即食食品」，而這正是李斯特菌被特別點名的類別：它在冷藏溫度下仍會生長，食物放得愈久，菌量就愈多。這就是開瓶後不該硬撐的理由。
zh.freezer: 打算自己醃之前請先讀這一段。鹽和酸殺不死寄生蟲，冷凍才可以。公告的殺蟲條件是：−20 °C 以下合計七天；或 −35 °C 凍到全硬後再於 −35 °C 保持十五小時；或 −35 °C 凍到全硬後再於 −20 °C 保持二十四小時——而且這些條件可能不適用厚度超過約六英吋的魚體。鹽漬和醋漬或許能降低寄生蟲風險，但無法消除；線蟲幼蟲曾在極濃鹽水中存活四週。所以冷凍是「醃漬前施加於生魚」的處理，不是保存成品的方法，這裡也因此不給冷凍期限：做好之後再冷凍的醃鯡魚會變糊、湯汁混濁。
zh.thawing: 要醃之前，生鯡魚請放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫。成品不該冷凍，所以也沒有解凍的問題。
spoilage: 醃汁變混濁、牽絲或黏滑。
魚片轉灰褐、變糊或一夾就散。
在醋香和香料味之外出現腐臭或酵母味。
瓶蓋鼓起，或瓶內冒出氣泡。
tips: 每片都要壓在液面下；露出來的先壞。
每次用乾淨的叉子，夾出來的不要放回瓶裡。
在瓶蓋上寫開封日期，並嚴守那個短窗口。
自己醃的話，生鯡魚要先冷凍——醋不是控制手段。

faq.a: 未開封的市售瓶裝在 4 °C 以下 4～6 個月。開瓶後 1～2 週——這是刻意保守的數字，因為沒有公告值。

faq.q: 醃漬可以殺死寄生蟲嗎？
faq.a: 不行。鹽漬和醋漬可能降低風險但無法消除；幼蟲曾在濃鹽水中存活數週。符合公告條件的冷凍才是控制手段，而且必須在醃漬之前完成。
這裡不給期限，而且冷凍的重點也不在保存成品。成品解凍後會變糊、湯汁混濁。請改為在醃漬前冷凍生魚。

faq.q: 為什麼醃鯡魚要注意李斯特菌？
faq.a: 因為它是冷藏保存期很長的即食魚製品，而李斯特菌在冷藏溫度下仍會生長。這就是開瓶後不該硬撐的原因。
